---
toc: false
repo-actions: false
format:
  html:
    anchor-sections: false
    grid:
      sidebar-width: 0px
      body-width: 1250px
      margin-width: 200px
      gutter-width: 2em 
title-block-banner: none
listing:
  - id: testimonial-carousel
    template: home/testimonials-carousel-template.ejs
    contents: home/testimonials.yaml
  - id: news-card
    template: home/news-carousel-template.ejs
    contents: news/news
    sort: "date desc"
  - id: events-card
    template: home/events-carousel-template.ejs
    contents: events/events/*.qmd
    sort: "date desc"
include-in-header:
  - text: |
        <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
        <script src="assets/javascript/impact_counter.js" defer></script>
        <style>

        /*Remove gap between navbar and main content*/
        .quarto-title, 
        .quarto-header, 
        header {
            margin-bottom: 0 !important;
            padding-bottom: 0 !important;
        }
        main#quarto-document-content {
            margin-top: 0 !important;
            padding-top: 0 !important;
            margin-bottom: 0 !important;
        }

        .page-rows-contents {
          grid-template-rows: [content-top] minmax(max-content, 1fr) [content-bottom] minmax(0, max-content) [page-bottom];
        }
        .brand-banner-color {
          background-color: var(--osc-accent);
        }

        .banner-image-container {
          height: clamp(240px, 32vw, 400px);
          overflow: hidden;
        }
        .banner-image {
          width: 100%;
          height: 100%;
          object-fit: cover;
          object-position: center;
          display: block;
        }

        .bg-banner-light {
          background-color: #F6F7F4;
        }

        .bg-banner-dark {
          background-color: #043D1E;
        }

        .text-green {
          color: #BDF0D1 !important;
        }
        .metric-color {
          color: #043D1E;
        }
        .testimonial-carousel .carousel-indicators {
            margin-bottom: -1.8rem;
          }
        .testimonial-carousel .carousel-indicators [data-bs-target] {   
            height: 10px;
            width: 10px;
            border-radius: 50%;
            background-color: var(--osc-accent);
        }
        .quote-icon {
            opacity: 0.1;
        }

        .explore-card {
         transition: transform 0.25s ease;
        }

        .explore-card:hover {
          transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        /*Events and news card arrow*/
        .card-arrow {
          position: absolute;
          right: 1.25rem;
          top: 50%;
          font-size: 1.25rem;
          color: #333333e3;

        }
        
         .newsletter-button.btn-primary{
            transition: transform .15s ease;
          }
          .newsletter-button.btn-primary:hover {
            transform: scale(1.05);
          }

        </style>
---

# LMU Open Science Center {.text-white }

[The researcher-led LMU Open Science Center (OSC) advances research excellence at LMU Munich by promoting open, responsible, and reproducible practices.]{.fs-5}

[Learn more about OSC](about/index.qmd){.btn .btn-outline-light .mt-2 .fw-bold .learn-more-button}

## What We Offer {.text-white .text-center .border-0 .lh-base .fw-2}

[Whether you are a student, early-career researcher, or professor — there's a place for you at the Open Science Center.]{.lh-lg}

::: {.row .row-cols-1 .row-cols-sm-2 .row-cols-md-3 .text-center  .g-4 .mt-3}

::: {.col}
```{=html}
<div class="card explore-card h-100 border border-success-subtle rounded-3 shadow-sm">
  <div class="card-body d-flex flex-column p-4">
    <div class="d-flex align-items-center justify-content-between mb-2">
      <h5 class="mb-0 card-title text-start fw-semibold" style="font-size: 1.15rem;">Community</h5>
      <div class="bg-light rounded-3 d-inline-flex align-items-center justify-content-center" style="width:50px;height:50px;color:var(--osc-accent);">
        <i class="bi bi-people fs-5"></i>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p class="card-text flex-grow-1 text-start">Meet the researchers, advocates, and partners shaping open science at LMU and beyond.</p>
    <a href="/people/" class="stretched-link" aria-label="Meet the OSC Community"></a>
  </div>
</div>
```
:::
